en: A close-up of a purple postage stamp affixed to a postcard. The stamp shows a detailed engraved image of a large neoclassical theatre building with multiple wings and pitched roofs. Decorative floral scrollwork frames the scene. At the top is the wording 'EESTI POST'. At the bottom, the denomination '30' appears in both lower corners with the words 'KOLMKÜMMEND MARKA' in a ribbon. Below the building is the caption 'TEATER-ESTONIA'. There are black postmark cancellation marks across the stamp and onto the surrounding postcard paper.
